records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Your workspace for Orchard Media is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: One step to get Orchard Media moving in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Felix,

Thanks again for flagging that notification badge last week 
cu that ticket is closed now, but tell me if it reappears.

Since then things have been quiet on your side, so I wanted to check in. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project 
cu that's the step that makes the first week genuinely useful.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Nadia
